ValidationRule.description: REQ-008. Sending an escalated case back to a working status needs return guidance.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Escalated"), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status, "New"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Working"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Waiting on Customer")), ISBLANK(Return_Guidance__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter return guidance before sending an escalated case back to L1.
